## Practice Assignment 1

After creating an *r script* with a script that prints all the integers between 1 and 10 to screen, i was asked to

> *Create an R Markdown file with a few introductory markdown comments and the cells with the code*


**The code from the R script:**
```{r code}
for (i in 1:10){
  print (i)
}
```
